SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S.A - D. 2305.
C. 2 Station,
REPORT
Date April 8, 1931.
Subject (in full) Suggested establishment of a Criminal Records Office.
Made by and Forwarded by J. Dickson SCI
Sir,
Further to my report of April 1, and the remarks of the
Commissioner thereon, I respectfully beg to bring the following
points to your notice, as it appears to me that the position of
the S. .P. in forming a C.R.C. is not quite understood.
The formation of a C.R.C. where there is no F.P.B. is a
fairly straight forward job, which no doubt could be undertaken
by any responsible police officer who had acquired the necessary
data from some Force already operating one. The fact which
appears to have been lost sight of is that there has been a
F.P.B. working in the S.M.P. for the past 20 years and that over
150,000 records are at present on file, these will have to be
transferred to the C.R.C.
The responsibility for the correct transfer will have to be
undertaken by a finger print expert and I think it only fair to
whoever has to assume that responsibility, that he should be
allowed to gather his own data otherwise he is immediately
working on second hand information, which however accurately it
may have been gathered is never altogether satisfactory.
As Mr. Baker has no knowledge of finger prints I cannot see
how he can collect all the necessary data and if I am to collect
it I would much prefer to do so in my own way.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
J. Dickson
D. S. I.
D. C. (Crime & Special Branches).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 S.A - D. 2305.
C. 2 巡捕房，
报告
日期 1931年4月8日。
主题（全称）建议设立刑事记录办公室。
由 J. Dickson 警司呈报并转递

阁下：
继我4月1日的报告及警务处长对此的批示之后，谨提请阁下注意以下几点，因为在我看来，人们并未完全理解上海公共租界工部局警务处在组建刑事记录办公室（C.R.C.）方面的处境。
在没有指纹局（F.P.B.）的情况下组建刑事记录办公室是一项相当直接的工作，无疑可以由任何已从其他已运作此类机构的警力部门获取必要数据的负责警官来承担。似乎被忽视的一个事实是，过去20年间，上海公共租界工部局警务处一直有一个指纹局在运作，目前存档的记录超过150,000份，这些记录必须移交给刑事记录办公室。
正确移交的责任必须由一名指纹专家承担，我认为对于任何必须承担该责任的人来说，公平的做法是允许他自行收集数据，否则他将立即基于二手信息开展工作，无论这些信息收集得多么准确，总归不能令人完全满意。
由于贝克先生不具备指纹知识，我看不出他如何能收集所有必要的数据；如果由我来收集，我更愿意按我自己的方式进行。
阁下，
您忠实的仆人，
J. Dickson
副警司
副处长（刑事与特别处）。

Date April 3, 1931.
(C. & S B.) Office Notes

C. P.

Nearly all modern Police Forces have a
Criminal Record Office where the complete record
of a prisoner can be turned up quickly. Not all
Forces have a Finger Print Bureau but depend on a
central clearing house like Scotland Yard. The
S.M.P. have depended on the finger print records and
the difficulties are mentioned in attached report.
I have had this matter in mind for the past year and
have discussed it on several occasions with Mr. Gerrard
who considered it essential and wished me to start as
soon as possible. I have some knowledge of the matter
myself from what I saw at 'home' but not sufficient to
start an office properly. I therefore recommend that
S.I. Dickson be granted two weeks extra long leave
with pay to visit Scotland Yard or any other Police
Force which may be able to help him to obtain inform-
ation to start a Criminal Record Office here.

D. C. (C. & S.B.).

（批：J.C (CrS) From my own experience I think
the details of Scotland Yard's C.R.O. could
be mastered in one day - he states in
attending a Senior Officers Course there in
July - if S.I.J. Dickson gets in touch
with him through John Pollock he, he
could collect the necessary data.
I do not think an extension of leave is
necessary at John Pollock he would pay
S.I.J. Dickson's expenses. I am in full
agreement with you as to the necessity for
a C.R.O.
Elph 6/4）

（批：P.A. (Crd)
inform
S.I. Dickson
7/4）

日期 1931年4月3日。
（刑事与特别处）办公笔记

警务处长

几乎所有现代警察部队都设有刑事记录办公室，可以迅速调取囚犯的完整记录。并非所有警力部门都设有指纹局，而是依赖像苏格兰场这样的中央清算中心。上海公共租界工部局警务处一直依赖指纹记录，相关困难已在附呈报告中提及。
过去一年我一直关注此事，并多次与杰拉德先生讨论，他认为此事至关重要，并希望我尽快启动。基于我在“本国”所见，我对此事有一定了解，但不足以妥善启动一个办公室。因此，我建议给予副警司 Dickson 两周额外的带薪长假，以便访问苏格兰场或其他能够提供帮助、使其获得在此启动刑事记录办公室所需信息的警察部队。

副处长（刑事与特别处）。

（批注：J.C (刑事处) 根据我的经验，我认为苏格兰场刑事记录办公室的细节可以在一天内掌握——他在7月参加那里的高级警官课程时曾如此表示——如果副警司 J. Dickson 通过约翰·波洛克与他取得联系，他就能收集到必要的数据。
我认为无需延长假期，约翰·波洛克会支付副警司 J. Dickson 的费用。我完全同意你关于设立刑事记录办公室必要性的看法。
Elph 4月6日）

（批注：警务助理处长（刑事记录科）
通知
副警司 Dickson
4月7日）

File No.______
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
0. 2. Station,
REPORT
Date April 1, 1931.
Subject (in full) Suggested establishment of a Criminal Records Office
(Hereinafter referred to as the C.R.O.)
Made by ______ and ______ Forwarded by Jllerson DSI.
Sir,
Re our conversation on the above subject some time ago I
beg to put forward the following points for consideration.
1. The present system of filing finger print records with the
prisoners criminal record on the back causes most of the work
to be done by foreign finger print experts owing to the fact
that the files are numbered by means of a finger print classi-
fication.
The finger prints of prisoners have to be removed from the
files several times for additions or alterations to the
criminal record on the back and with the large number of files
and their complicated numbering there is always a possibility
of a record being mislaid.
If the criminal record is kept in a separate file with an
ordinary file number this is not likely to occur.
With a C.R.O. working finger prints would be filed as at
present but instead of having the convictions recorded on the
back, there would merely be a C.R.O. number and the full record
of the prisoner would be found under this number in the C.R.O.,
thus a prisoners finger prints once filed would remain in the
file.
2. The Identification Records of prisoners are at present filed
in three different places according to whether the prisoners
sentence has commenced, is awaiting execution order for
commencement, or is released. When he is released the iden-
tification record is filed under its station and number, thus
a prisoner with ten previous convictions has ten identification
records in various parts of the storeroom. In the event of
information being required by anyone regarding this prisoners
pages.zh:
档案号______
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
0. 2. 巡捕房，
报告
日期 1931年4月1日。
主题（全称）建议设立刑事记录办公室
（以下简称 C.R.O.）
由 ______ 撰写并由 Jllerson 副警司转递。
阁下：
关于不久前我们就上述主题进行的谈话，谨提出以下几点供考虑。
1. 目前将指纹记录与囚犯刑事记录一起归档在背面的制度，导致大部分工作必须由外籍指纹专家完成，这是因为档案是通过指纹分类法进行编号的。
为了在背面的刑事记录上进行增补或修改，必须多次从档案中取出囚犯的指纹卡，鉴于档案数量庞大且编号复杂，记录错放的可能性始终存在。
如果刑事记录保存在具有普通档案编号的独立档案中，这种情况就不太可能发生。
在刑事记录办公室运作下，指纹将像目前一样归档，但不再在背面记录定罪情况，而仅标注一个刑事记录办公室编号，囚犯的完整记录可在刑事记录办公室中通过该编号查到，因此囚犯的指纹一旦归档，将保留在档案中。
2. 囚犯的身份识别记录目前根据囚犯刑期是否已开始、是否等待开始执行的命令，或是否已释放，分别存放在三个不同的地方。当囚犯被释放时，身份识别记录按其巡捕房和编号归档，因此一名有十次前科的囚犯，其十份身份识别记录分散在储藏室的不同部分。如果有人需要查询该囚犯的

antecedents, it means his finger print record has to be
removed from the files, all his station numbers copied out
and each record searched for separately.
With a C.R.O. all his identification records would be
contained in his dossier in the C.R.O. which could be reached
in a very few minutes.
It must be understood that the adoption of a C.R.O. would
not change the present finger print system but only the
criminal record system.
3. The third reason which I feel justifies the establishment
of a C.R.O. is this:- In the S.M.P. a prisoner on arrest and
conviction may carry no fewer than seven numbers relating to
different branches, and sections of the service which may
have come in contact with him in the course of his imprison-
ment viz:- 1) Station No.; 2) Court No.; 3) Crime Register No.;
4) M.O. No.; 5) Gaol No.; 6) Photo No.; 7) F.P.B. No.; apart
from an special registry numbers which may be given. So
far as I am aware no office cross-indexes these numbers, so
that they could supply the reference number of any given section
which it might be necessary to consult after the prisoner is
sentenced or released.
At present the F.P.B. is working daily with all the sections
mentioned and it is often found that whilst one section is in
possession of certain particulars and numbers they are not in
possession of the data necessary to turn out quickly a file
on the same case in another section. Admittedly the files
can always be found but often only after considerable search.
In a C.R.O. by a simple method of bookkeeping the cross-
indexing could be done in such a manner that a few minutes

过往经历，这意味着必须从档案中取出其指纹记录，抄录其所有巡捕房编号，并分别搜寻每一份记录。
有了刑事记录办公室，他的所有身份识别记录都将包含在刑事记录办公室的卷宗中，只需几分钟即可调取。
必须明确的是，采用刑事记录办公室不会改变目前的指纹系统，而只会改变刑事记录系统。
3. 我认为证明设立刑事记录办公室正当性的第三个理由如下：在上海公共租界工部局警务处，一名被捕并定罪的囚犯可能拥有不少于七个与不同部门和分支相关的编号，这些部门可能在囚禁期间与其有过接触，即：1) 巡捕房编号；2) 法庭编号；3) 犯罪登记编号；4) 医务官编号；5) 监狱编号；6) 照片编号；7) 指纹局编号；此外还可能有特殊的登记编号。据我所知，没有办公室对这些编号进行交叉索引，以便在囚犯被判刑或释放后，提供可能需要查阅的任何特定部门的参考编号。
目前，指纹局每天与上述所有部门打交道，经常发现虽然某个部门掌握某些具体信息和编号，但他们并不具备快速调出另一部门同一案件档案所需的数据。诚然，档案总能找到，但往往需要经过大量搜索。
在刑事记录办公室中，通过简单的簿记方法，可以进行交叉索引，使得只需几分钟

would suffice to give the reference number of any section
wanted.
Those are the three main points and it is difficult to give
a fuller explanation on paper without confusing the issue.
Points which of course must be considered are:-
1) Justification Is the work involved in organising the office
going to be justified by results ? So far as the Finger
Print Bureau is concerned I think it is justified. As
regards the C.R.O. acting as a clearing house for all
sections and their reference numbers, I think with the
variety of numbers now in use some such thing is necessary.
2) Expense ? This should not be very considerable, but I
could give more details of this if allowed to visit New
Scotland Yard.
3) Accomodation ? As for No. 2.
4) Staff ? I should say that no increase in the present
foreign staff of the F.P.B. would be necessary, but addi-
tional Chinese staff would be required at least during the
organisation.
The details mentioned would have to be gone into more fully
after first hand information had been secured from some Force
which already has a Finger Print Bureau and a Criminal Record
Office working together.
For this purpose I would suggest New Scotland Yard and if
time and authority be given me I am quite willing to visit
the Yard and study their system and to forward a detailed
report from home which, should it be decided to proceed with
the scheme, would allow for its inclusion in 1932 estimates.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
J. Dickson.
D. S. I.
D. C. (Crime & Special Branches)

以上是三个主要要点，如果不使问题混淆，很难在纸面上给出更充分的解释。
当然必须考虑的要点包括：
1) 正当性：组织该办公室所涉及的工作是否能由成果证明其正当性？就指纹局而言，我认为是正当的。至于作为所有部门及其参考号码清算中心的刑事记录办公室，我认为鉴于目前使用的各种编号，某种此类机构是必要的。
2) 费用？这不应非常巨大，但如果允许我访问新苏格兰场，我可以提供更详细的细节。
3) 场地？同第2点。
4) 人员？我认为无需增加指纹局现有的外籍人员，但在组织期间至少需要增加中方人员。
在从已同时运作指纹局和刑事记录办公室的警力部门获得第一手信息后，必须对上述细节进行更深入的探讨。
为此，我建议访问新苏格兰场，如果时间和权限允许，我非常愿意前往该处研究其系统，并从本国提交一份详细报告，如果决定推进该方案，该报告可将其纳入1932年的预算估算中。
阁下，
您忠实的仆人，
J. Dickson.
副警司
副处长（刑事与特别处）
